description: The docs website: gh-pages deploys the site built from the root lock file, so lock maintenance and site dependency updates are reviewed by hand. A PEP 621 mkdocs-redirects bump is refused because 1.2.3 pulls in properdocs, which injects a banner into the docs build

packageRules.description: [disable] 1.2.3 adds a dependency on properdocs, a MkDocs fork that injects a switch-away-from-mkdocs banner into the build; stay on the mkdocs-only 1.2.2 pin so no PR is opened until the migration is decided
